command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin work/photomap-straighten-20260912
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/photomap-straighten-20260912)"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "93638a04d2cebc3bc55c910174be98f3b056cdff"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx')
text = path.read_text()
old_import = 'import { MapPhotoGalleryPane } from "./MapPhotoGalleryPane";\n'
if 'MapTrackpadZoom' not in text:
    if old_import not in text:
        raise SystemExit('PlaceMap import anchor missing')
    text = text.replace(old_import, old_import + 'import { MapTrackpadZoom } from "./MapTrackpadZoom";\n', 1)
old_mount = '        <MapSizeUpdater />\n        <MapProjectionTracker onProjectorChange={handleProjectorChange} />'
if '<MapTrackpadZoom />' not in text:
    if old_mount not in text:
        raise SystemExit('PlaceMap mount anchor missing')
    text = text.replace(old_mount, '        <MapSizeUpdater />\n        <MapTrackpadZoom />\n        <MapProjectionTracker onProjectorChange={handleProjectorChange} />', 1)
path.write_text(text)
PY
cd frontend
npm run test -- src/components/map/trackpadZoom.test.ts src/components/map/mapDisplayConfig.test.ts
npm run build
cd ..
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-e2e-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" ./scripts/quality/e2e.sh e2e/visual/map-trackpad-zoom.spec.ts --project=chromium
git diff --check
git add frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx
git commit -m 'Wire trackpad zoom controller into public map'
git push origin HEAD:work/photomap-straighten-20260912
printf 'published_sha=' && git rev-parse HEAD
